title: Stop sharing intimate details online about your own inner life immediately!
content: Generalization’s should be ok, just no specific details please. Learn to empty and feel with your mind while thinking with your heart. Trust your instincts and intuition but don’t follow them blindly. Try to balance everything in your inner and outer life. Learn to stay centered and calm by maintaining a steady meditative focus on the interplay of breath and heartbeat throughout the day. Be aware of your own weaknesses and recognize when they are being used against you. Practice silencing your inner monologue and learn to think without words.
